neighbours.label: stock-market trading text (market makers, flash crash, market breadth, short / leveraged positions): fires on function words and ' market' while the passage is about securities trading
fire: During the flash crash of August 2015, hundreds of exchange-traded funds fell far below the value of their holdings.
Market makers, sometimes called specialists, hold an inventory of shares and quote a bid and an offer all day.
The S&P 500 held support at 3900, but market breadth has been narrowing for a month.
Algorithmic traders pulled their orders within seconds, and the market for index futures went into free fall.
A margin call forces the trader to close the leveraged position or post more collateral at once.
Selling pressure fed on itself as stop-loss orders, forced liquidation and market panic drove prices lower.
When volatility spikes, option dealers hedge by selling futures, which pushes the market down further.
The Dow dropped nine percent in minutes before circuit breakers halted trading in most stocks.
quiet: During the village fair in August, hundreds of visitors crowd the flea market beside the church.
The fish market, sometimes called the old quay, sells crab and mussels from dawn until noon.
Simmer the bones for three hours to make a rich stock for the soup.
The exchange students from Lyon stayed with host families for a month.
The farmer took his livestock down to the lower pasture before the snow came.
They finally paid off the mortgage on the house after twenty-five years of saving.
Grocery bills rose again this winter, and many families cut back on meat.
The tailor learned his trade from his father and passed it on to his sons.

notes: Card: ' market' x4, ' Market' x2, ' to', ' or', ' a', all in trading text (Flash Crash, market makers, dynamic hedging, rolling contracts); as the - pole it promotes ' move', ' stock', ' volatile', ' options'. The + pole is the exchange-venue side (crypto exchanges, 'on the exchange's trading floors'). Probes: Flash Crash 0.79, market makers 0.68, market breadth 0.36, stocks fell 0.25, short or leveraged 0.19; farmers market 0.00. Near misses use market / stock / exchange / trade in other senses, plus household finance.
